notes.title: NOX AETERNA - Major update
notes.content:
I have updated the game to now use the Godot engine.
This allowed me to finally to fix the screen flickering issue with the steam overlay.
Additionally, I have made a complete overhaul of the main menu and added fog effects.

notes.title: NOX AETERNA - Veil of Darkness - NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to the world of gloom[/h1]

It's finally here, NOX AETERNA is released!

[h3]What else is new? [/h3]
In addition to a few small corrections, there are now also achievements so that you can be sure not to miss any of the subplots and Easter eggs in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466833/3b45553aab205c0d46d19783a6beb0639e4a6219.jpg[/img]
